lead_descriptions.text: Who We Are: South Philadelphia High School is a Community School serving over 600 students in grades 9-12. It collaborates with the City of Philadelphia, the School District, community-based organizations, and the residents of Philadelphia to pave the way for student success. | What We Do: Our students are supported by two Community School Coordinators. Volunteers are needed to distribute weekly groceries to students and families, engage with students in the gaming room, and support special events like resource fairs, and more! Scroll down to Program Opportunities to get involved today!
